Senses.Explanation: To cut off everyone’s tongue is to leave all other speakers without a viable reply or verbal opening. Comments apply the hyperbolic bodily image to a turn, departure, blow, or wall-facing stance whose handling is said to pre-empt the field; it reports a public verdict, not literal mutilation.
